Manchow Instant Noodles
By: ravikumar
Published: Wednesday, January 10, 2018 - 3:54am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Manchow Instant Noodles
1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Boil 1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water 3 Step 2: 4 Add noodles and the seasoning mix to the boiling water and cook for 2-3 mins. Stir Occasionally. 5 Serve Hot!

About

Chings is a popular Chinese brand in India and Have Verity of Product like Chings Manchow Instant Noodles, It is a very good in taste and Delicious. It is Quick and Easy manchow Instant noodles recipe to make within few Minutes.
